title: On Ricci forms of canonical metrics over noncompact complex manifolds
summary: In this paper, we study several types of geometric problems related to the Ricci curvature on noncompact complex manifolds, such as the existence of Kähler-Einstein metrics on complete Kähler manifolds with negative Ricci curvature, which can be seen as an improvement of the main theorem in Cheng-Yau [4]; the existence of canonical Hermitian metrics with prescribed Ricci curvature on complete Hermitian manifolds, which can be regarded as noncompact versions of the Gauduchon conjecture on certain complete complex surfaces.
